Tìm hiểu thêm Sản Phẩm Chất Lượng Hàng Đầu Công ty hiện sản xuất trên 200 mặt hàng đáp ứng nhu cầu ẩm thực đa dạng của người tiêu dùng; đồng thời góp phần làm gia tăng giá trị hạt gạo Việt Nam. Sản phẩm khác Vina Miến (Miến Đậu Xanh) Bánh tráng Bánh Gạo Trà Hòa Tan - Thanh Nhiệt Bánh Phồng Tôm Sản phẩm từ gạo Sản phẩm hữu cơ Sản phẩm ăn liền Bột dinh dưỡng Snack - Bánh kẹo Bột thực phẩm Hành Trình Sản Phẩm Bích Chi – Từ Hạt Gạo Quê Hương Đến Niềm Tự Hào Ẩm Thực Tại Bích Chi, mỗi sản phẩm không chỉ là món ăn mà còn là câu chuyện gìn giữ tinh hoa quê hương. Chúng tôi tự hào chọn lựa nguồn nguyên liệu từ những vùng đất giàu truyền thống: bột gạo trắng mịn từ làng nghề trăm năm Sa Đéc, hạt gạo thơm dẻo từ cánh đồng lúa bát ngát Đồng Tháp. Từng hạt gạo, từng mẻ bột đều thấm đẫm công sức và tình yêu lao động của người dân miền Tây. Đó chính là nguồn cảm hứng để Bích Chi không ngừng sáng tạo, mang đến những sản phẩm chất lượng, giữ trọn hương vị tự nhiên, an toàn cho sức khỏe. Câu chuyện của Bích Chi là hành trình kết nối giữa truyền thống và hiện đại – nơi giá trị địa phương được nâng tầm để vươn xa, mang niềm tự hào ẩm thực Việt đến với mọi gia đình. Vina Mien - Mung Bean Vermicelli Rice Paper Rice Crackers Instant Tea - Cooling Effect Prawn crackers Rice noodles and Rice Paper Organic Products Instant Food Nutrition powder Snack & Cookies Food powder Bich Chi’s Product Journey – From Local Rice Grains to Culinary Pride At Bich Chi, every product is more than just food – it is a story of preserving the essence of our homeland. We proudly source ingredients from regions rich in tradition: silky white rice flour from the hundred-year-old craft village of Sa Đéc, and fragrant, tender grains from the vast rice fields of Đồng Tháp. Each grain of rice, each batch of flour, carries the dedication and love of the hardworking people of the Mekong Delta. This is the inspiration that drives Bich Chi to continuously innovate, creating high-quality products that retain their natural flavors and ensure health and safety. The story of Bich Chi is a journey of connection between tradition and modernity – where local values are elevated and shared, bringing the pride of Vietnamese cuisine to every family. pages.title: About
pages.mainText: English Tiếng ViệtEnglish AboutProductPrawn crackersRice noodles & Rice PaperOrganic ProductsInstant FoodNutrition PowderSnack & Cookies CookiesSnackFood PowderInstant Tea - Cooling EffectRice CrackersRice PaperVina Mien (Mung Bean Vermicelli)Sản phẩm khácShareholderNewsCuisineRaw material areaContact About About Bich ChiTimeline of Bich ChiVision & MissionProduct quality standardsQuality CertificationAcheievements About Bich Chi BICH CHI FOOD COMPANY Bich Chi Food Company is now operating effectively in the food processing sector in Vietnam. Formerly Bich Chi Power Factory established in 1966 is specialized in producing brown rice flour, bean flour gives the kind of market for domestic consumption. Inheriting the advantages famous specialty ingredients togerther flour Sa Dec village, located in the MeKong Delta rice basket, with factory area of about 33,000m2. Bich Chi Food Company has got strength in producing high - quality products branded Bich Chi. With a dynamic management team, skilled technical staff expertise, and skilled workers the company has developed and successfully applied the quality management system ISO 9001:2000, HACCP and the company also is looking forward to apply BRC, FSSC. Bich Chi Food includes over 100 products, in accordance with the culinary needs of diverse consumers. In those areas include the famous traditional products of Bich Chi as: Rice noodles, rice paper, rive vermicelli, fine rice vermicelli... and instant products as Pho, tapioca rice sticks, rice vermicelli, bean thread and... Prawn cracker is a regional specialty item at Sa Dec city. In early 2006, Bich Chi Food company built a factory specialized in manufacturing Prawn crackers with 2,500 tons per year and reaching to 8,000 tons in the year 2016. Bich Chi products meet rigorous standards in the demanding markets such as Europe, Japan, Korea... so the number of customers, more and more orders, output increasing export has demostrated the right investment of board of directors. With the motto "Prestige - Quality - Competitive Prices", brand reputation has put Bich Chi Food outreach not only to meet domestic demand but also to export to many markets such as: Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia, South Korea, Japan, USA, Canada, EU, Senegal in Africa, Ukraine and some Arab countries... Timeline of Bich Chi 1966 Established Bich Chi powder factory 2000 Equitized and renamed Bich Chi Food Company, officially operating since 2001 2010 The company was approved by the State Securities Commission to become a public company 2010 - 2020 The company invested in an additional rice paper factory, expanded the factory to increase the production capacity of shrimp chips, and expanded the rice noodle factory. 2022 The company has products that achieve National Brand Vision & Mission Vision Becoming a leading food manufacturing enterprise in Vietnam with sufficient management capacity to adapt to the globalization process. Contribute to improving the culinary life of not only Vietnamese society but also the world through the production and trading of high quality food. Mission Through the production and sales of high-value products and services that meet the needs of the times, we aim to: Bring satisfaction to consumers. Bringing stable life and development to employees. Become a business with a worldwide position and support. Bich Chi Food Company is now operating effectively in the food processing sector in Vietnam. Formerly Bich Chi Power Factory established in 1966 is specialized in producing brown rice flour, bean flour gives the kind of market for domestic consumption.
...
The company currently produces over 200 products to meet the diverse culinary needs of consumers; At the same time, it contributes to increasing the value of Vietnamese rice grains.
...
At Bich Chi, every product is more than just food – it is a story of preserving the essence of our homeland. We proudly source ingredients from regions rich in tradition: silky white rice flour from the hundred-year-old craft village of Sa Đéc, and fragrant, tender grains from the vast rice fields of Đồng Tháp. Each grain of rice, each batch of flour, carries the dedication and love of the hardworking people of the Mekong Delta.
...
This is the inspiration that drives Bich Chi to continuously innovate, creating high-quality products that retain their natural flavors and ensure health and safety. The story of Bich Chi is a journey of connection between tradition and modernity – where local values are elevated and shared, bringing the pride of Vietnamese cuisine to every family.

searchResults.title: About
searchResults.highlight:
Bich Chi Food Company is now operating effectively in the food processing sector in Vietnam. Formerly Bich Chi Power Factory established in 1966 is specialized in producing brown rice flour, bean flour gives the kind of market for domestic consumption. Inheriting the advantages famous specialty ingredients togerther flour Sa Dec village, located in the MeKong Delta rice basket, with factory area of about 33,000m2. Bich Chi Food Company has got strength in producing high - quality products branded Bich Chi. With a dynamic management team, skilled technical staff expertise, and skilled workers the company has developed and successfully applied the quality management system ISO 9001:2000, HACCP and the company also is looking forward to apply BRC, FSSC.
...
Bich Chi Food includes over 100 products, in accordance with the culinary needs of diverse consumers. In those areas include the famous traditional products of Bich Chi as: Rice noodles, rice paper, rive vermicelli, fine rice vermicelli... and instant products as Pho, tapioca rice sticks, rice vermicelli, bean thread and... Prawn cracker is a regional specialty item at Sa Dec city. In early 2006, Bich Chi Food company built a factory specialized in manufacturing Prawn crackers with 2,500 tons per year and reaching to 8,000 tons in the year 2016.
...
The company invested in an additional rice paper factory, expanded the factory to increase the production capacity of shrimp chips, and expanded the rice noodle factory.

## Food Processing
...
### Business description: Bich Chi
...
Bich Chi Food Company is a Vietnam-based food processing company. The Company is engaged in the processing and manufacturing of various types of food, mainly shrimp crackers, rice flour and other types of flour from green beans, soya beans, lotus seeds, black sesame, brown rice, etc., including instant nutritional powdered drinks. Its other main products include various kinds of dry noodles and rice papers. In addition, the Company manufactures instant porridge, peanut brown rice candies, milk tea, grean tea powdered drinks and lemon tea drinks.
